TextBlock.Text: BANDA SEA, middle watch. The auxiliary took a torpedo forward eleven days ago and has been making six knots ever since. She carries the Russian detachment's remaining missile stocks and the only workshop between here and home. You have the heavy cruiser, a Project 11356 frigate, a Felon and a Flanker off the enclave's dispersal field on Biak, and a Chinese J-16D lent for the passage. Your bombers can reach but they cannot loiter, and every sortie you fly tells the other side where you are going. Get her south-east past the corridor. This is not a raid. If you start a fleet action to protect a workshop ship you will lose both.
Russian detachment commander, to his own force
Get the auxiliary home. The Australian patrol is professional and it does not chase; it will not start a fight today unless you give it a reason.

Auxiliary: Bring the auxiliary through to the south-east Cruiser: Do not lose the heavy cruiser Traffic: Harm no neutral shipping Restraint: Avoid a fleet action you cannot finish: harm nothing of the coalition's

Pyotr Velikiy, a Project 11356 frigate and Kuznetsov's covering group; a Felon, a Su-30SM2, a MiG-29K, a Su-33 and a lent J-16D; a Tu-160 and two Tu-95MS already airborne. One damaged auxiliary, and three neutral merchants on the same track. Opposing: an Australian patrol - a Hobart and an Anzac with an F-35A and a P-8A over them.
75 minutes. The operation ends when the clock runs out, and the main objective fails with it.
Destroying a neutral contact ends the operation in failure. Identify before you shoot.

Kirov-class (Pyotr Velikiy Upgrade), Russian Navy 21, SU-57 Felon (重刑犯), Su-30SM2, MIG-29 Family, Shenyang J-16A (歼-16A 潜龙), TU-160 Blackjack, Tu-95MS (X-101), Tu-95 With AS-15 (Kh-55) ALCM (more realistic nuke), 1143.5 Kuznetsov, Modern Russian Airbase (Large), Boeing P-8 Poseidon, RE-power: the resupply mod, the base game, this pack.
